en: A vintage postcard depicting a large, ornate, historic building in a European city. The foreground features a tree-lined esplanade or boulevard, with several elegant stone buildings visible. The image has a hand-tinted, early 20th-century look. The top left bears the inscription 'Sundsvall. Esplanaden. Bardach Foto.' The reverse side has the word 'BREVKORT' at the top and 'Carte Postale' in several languages underneath, along with a space for correspondence and address.
